# High-level design: Subscription domain Prepared 2026-10-07 from blueprint `fc71a1458dce`. Every diagram below is generated from the org’s own metadata; when the org changes, we regenerate this document. ## 1. Scope | | | |---|---| | Source | Salesforce org, 505 objects described | | Domain in scope | Subscription, Subscription Line | | Reference objects | Account, Contact, Opportunity, Product | | Target | PostgreSQL on Azure, services and admin app, released by CI/CD | | Data | Account 22 · Contact 20 · Opportunity 31 · Product 17 · Subscription 107 · Subscription Line 219 | ## 2. How we move it Six phases, one or more agents per phase, a review gate after each phase. A failed check goes to the Repair agent, whose fix is applied only after approval. ```mermaid flowchart LR SF[("Salesforce org
metadata and data")] P0["1 Discover
Extraction"] SF --> P0 P1["2 Design
Modelling"] P0 --> P1 P2["3 Build
Schema
Logic
Security"] P1 --> P2 P3["4 Migrate
Data load"] P2 --> P3 P4["5 Validate
Verification"] P3 --> P4 P5["6 Go-live
CI/CD pipeline"] P4 --> P5 P5 --> AZ[("Azure
PostgreSQL + App Service")] P4 -. "fails" .-> R["Repair agent"] -. "fix, after approval" .-> P2 classDef phase fill:#F3F1FC,stroke:#6666CC,color:#1F1F2E; class P0,P1,P2,P3,P4,P5 phase; ``` ## 3. Business processes ### 3.1 Subscription lifecycle Statuses come from the Status picklist; the notes come from the validation rules that guard each status. ```mermaid stateDiagram-v2 [*] --> Draft Draft --> Active Active --> Suspended Suspended --> Active Active --> Renewed Renewed --> [*] Draft --> Cancelled Active --> Cancelled Suspended --> Cancelled Cancelled --> [*] note right of Active needs MRR above zero end note note right of Cancelled needs a cancellation reason
cannot be reactivated end note ``` ### 3.2 Won deal becomes a subscription When an opportunity is marked Closed Won, a subscription is created for the account, once per deal. ```mermaid sequenceDiagram autonumber actor Rep as Sales rep participant O as Opportunity participant S as OpportunityService participant Sub as Subscription Rep->>O: set stage to Closed Won O->>S: after update: createSubscriptionsForWonDeals() S->>Sub: any subscription already created for this deal? alt none yet S->>Sub: insert subscription (term 12 months) else already exists S-->>O: skip (no duplicates) end Sub-->>Rep: subscription visible on the account ``` ### 3.3 Saving a subscription What happens, in Salesforce’s order, every time a subscription is saved: defaults, validation, status handling, the at-risk alert, and totals on the parent. ```mermaid sequenceDiagram autonumber actor U as User or integration participant SF as Subscription participant SubscriptionService as SubscriptionService U->>SF: create or update a subscription SF->>SubscriptionService: before save: applyDefaults() SF->>SF: validation rules (4) Note right of SF: Active Requires MRR
Cancellation Reason Required
End Date After Start Date
No Reactivation After Cancel SF->>SubscriptionService: after save: handleStatusChange() SubscriptionService-->>SF: insert Task participant Flow as Flow SF->>Flow: Subscription At Risk Alert Note right of Flow: when AND( Health_Score__c #lt; 50, Status__c = Active ) Flow-->>SF: create Task SF-->>U: saved, or the first failing rule’s message ``` ### 3.4 Subscription At Risk Alert Raises a check-in task when an active subscription drops below the at-risk health threshold. ```mermaid flowchart TD START(["Subscription created or updated
after save"]) FILTER{{"AND( Health Score #lt; 50, Status = Active )"}} START --> FILTER FILTER -- "no" --> SKIP(["no action"]) Create_Health_Check_Task["create Task
Create Health Check Task"] FILTER -- "yes" --> Create_Health_Check_Task classDef el fill:#F3F1FC,stroke:#6666CC,color:#1F1F2E; ``` ### 3.5 Renewal reminders A scheduled job raises a renewal task before each active subscription ends. ```mermaid flowchart TD A(["Nightly schedule"]) --> B["Find active subscriptions
ending within 30 days"] B --> C{"Any found?"} C -- "yes" --> D["Create a renewal task
for each owner"] C -- "no" --> E(["Done"]) D --> E classDef job fill:#EAFBF5,stroke:#2CDCAA,color:#1F1F2E; class A,B,D job; ``` ### 3.6 Case routing and escalation Assignment rules route each new case by country, service level and account type; escalation rules raise cases that miss their target time (outside the subscription domain; listed for completeness). ```mermaid flowchart TD S(["New case"]) C0{{"BillingCountry = US
SLA = Gold, Platinum
Type contains Customer"}} S --> C0 C0 -- "yes" --> R0["assign to assigned user"] C1{{"BillingCountry = US
SLA = Silver, Bronze
Type contains Customer"}} C0 -- "no" --> C1 C1 -- "yes" --> R1["assign to assigned user"] C2{{"BillingCountry ≠ US
SLA = Gold, Platinum
Type contains Customer"}} C1 -- "no" --> C2 C2 -- "yes" --> R2["assign to assigned user"] C3{{"BillingCountry ≠ US
SLA = Silver, Bronze
Type contains Customer"}} C2 -- "no" --> C3 C3 -- "yes" --> R3["assign to assigned user"] C4{{"Type contains Partner"}} C3 -- "no" --> C4 C4 -- "yes" --> R4["assign to assigned user"] C4 -- "no" --> N(["no change"]) ``` | Escalation rule | Applies when | |---|---| | 1 | BillingCountry = US; SLA = Platinum; Priority = High | | 2 | BillingCountry = US; SLA = Platinum; Priority = Medium,Low | | 3 | BillingCountry = US; SLA = Gold; Priority = High | | 4 | BillingCountry = US; SLA = Gold; Priority = Medium,Low | | 5 | BillingCountry = US; SLA = Silver | | 6 | BillingCountry = US; SLA = Bronze | | 7 | BillingCountry ≠ US; SLA = Gold,Platinum | | 8 | BillingCountry ≠ US; SLA = Silver,Bronze | ## 4. Data model ```mermaid erDiagram Account { varchar id PK varchar name text type varchar billing_country text customer_priority text sla text active numeric numberof_locations text upsell_opportunity varchar sla_serial_number } Contact { varchar id PK varchar name text level varchar languages } Opportunity { varchar id PK varchar name text stage_name numeric amount text delivery_installation_status varchar tracking_number varchar order_number varchar current_generators varchar main_competitors text loss_reason } Product { varchar id PK varchar name } Subscription { varchar id PK varchar subscription_number varchar account_id FK boolean auto_renew varchar cancellation_reason date end_date numeric health_score numeric monthly_recurring_revenue date start_date text status } SubscriptionLine { varchar id PK varchar line_number varchar subscription_id FK numeric quantity numeric unit_price varchar account_name numeric line_total } Account |o--o{ Contact : "Account ID" Account |o--o{ Opportunity : "Account ID" Contact |o--o{ Opportunity : "Contact ID" Subscription ||--|{ SubscriptionLine : "Subscription" Product |o--o{ SubscriptionLine : "Product" Account ||--|{ Subscription : "Account" Contact |o--o{ Subscription : "Primary Contact" Opportunity |o--o{ Subscription : "Source Opportunity" ``` ## 5. Security Each Salesforce profile or permission set becomes a database role. Field-level security becomes column grants. Subscriptions inherit access from their account, as in Salesforce. ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph SFS["Salesforce"] profile_Admin["Profile: Admin"] profile_Analytics_Cloud_Integration_User["Profile: Analytics Cloud Integration User"] permissionSet_Subscription_Management["Permission set: Subscription_Management"] OWD["Account sharing
(org-wide default)"] end subgraph PG["PostgreSQL"] PG_profile_Admin["role admin"] PG_profile_Analytics_Cloud_Integration_User["role analytics cloud integration user"] PG_permissionSet_Subscription_Management["role subscription_management"] RLS["row-level security
can_access_account()"] COL["column grants
(field-level security)"] end profile_Admin --> PG_profile_Admin PG_profile_Admin --> COL profile_Analytics_Cloud_Integration_User --> PG_profile_Analytics_Cloud_Integration_User PG_profile_Analytics_Cloud_Integration_User --> COL permissionSet_Subscription_Management --> PG_permissionSet_Subscription_Management PG_permissionSet_Subscription_Management --> COL OWD --> RLS SUB["Subscription and lines
inherit access from the account"] --> RLS ``` ## 6. Data migration Records load parent first, in dependency order, keeping every Salesforce record ID. ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph L0["Level 1"] Account["Account
22 rows"] Product2["Product
17 rows"] end subgraph L1["Level 2"] Contact["Contact
20 rows"] end subgraph L2["Level 3"] Opportunity["Opportunity
31 rows"] end subgraph L3["Level 4"] Subscription__c["Subscription
107 rows"] end subgraph L4["Level 5"] Subscription_Line__c["Subscription Line
219 rows"] end L0 --> L1 L1 --> L2 L2 --> L3 L3 --> L4 ``` ## 7. Status and open items | Item | Status | |---|---| | Formulas and roll-ups | 6 generated and checked against Salesforce values | | Validation rules | 6 compiled (checks and guards) | | Apex translated | SubscriptionService.applyDefaults | | Automations still to translate | OpportunityTrigger, SubscriptionTrigger, SubscriptionRenewalBatch | | Items Salesforce keeps | see the gap register (output/inventory/gap-register.md) |

# Low-level design: Subscription domain Prepared 2026-10-07 from blueprint `fc71a1458dce`. Field lists, rules and automations are generated from the org; the target design for each item is the strategy our generator applied. ## 1. Tables ### Account (`Account` → `account`) 22 rows. Sharing: ReadWrite. | Salesforce field | Label | Salesforce type | Column | PostgreSQL type | Required | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | Id | Account ID | id | id | varchar(18) | yes | | | Name | Account Name | string | name | varchar(255) | yes | | | Type | Account Type | picklist | type | text | | values: Prospect, Customer - Direct, Customer - Channel, Channel Partner / Reseller, Installation Partner, Technology Partner, Other | | BillingCountry | Billing Country | string | billing_country | varchar(80) | | | | SLA__c | SLA | picklist | sla | text | | values: Gold, Silver, Platinum, Bronze | ### Contact (`Contact` → `contact`) 20 rows. Sharing: ControlledByParent. | Salesforce field | Label | Salesforce type | Column | PostgreSQL type | Required | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | Id | Contact ID | id | id | varchar(18) | yes | | | Name | Full Name | string | name | varchar(121) | | | ### Opportunity (`Opportunity` → `opportunity`) 31 rows. Sharing: ReadWrite. | Salesforce field | Label | Salesforce type | Column | PostgreSQL type | Required | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | Id | Opportunity ID | id | id | varchar(18) | yes | | | Name | Name | string | name | varchar(120) | yes | | | StageName | Stage | picklist | stage_name | text | yes | values: Prospecting, Qualification, Needs Analysis, Value Proposition, Id. Decision Makers, Perception Analysis, Proposal/Price Quote, Negotiation/Review, Closed Won, Closed Lost | | Amount | Amount | currency | amount | numeric(18,2) | | | | Loss_Reason__c | Loss Reason | picklist | loss_reason | text | | values: Price, Timing, Competitor, No Budget, No Decision, Other | ### Product (`Product2` → `product2`) 17 rows. Sharing: ReadWrite. | Salesforce field | Label | Salesforce type | Column | PostgreSQL type | Required | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | Id | Product ID | id | id | varchar(18) | yes | | | Name | Product Name | string | name | varchar(255) | yes | | ### Subscription (`Subscription__c` → `subscription`) 107 rows. Sharing: ControlledByParent, inherited through Subscription__c.Account__c. | Salesforce field | Label | Salesforce type | Column | PostgreSQL type | Required | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | Id | Record ID | id | id | varchar(18) | yes | | | Name | Subscription Number | string | subscription_number | varchar(80) | | | | Account__c | Account | reference | account_id | varchar(18) | yes | → | | Auto_Renew__c | Auto Renew | boolean | auto_renew | boolean | | default false | | Cancellation_Reason__c | Cancellation Reason | string | cancellation_reason | varchar(255) | | | | End_Date__c | End Date | date | end_date | date | yes | | | Health_Score__c | Health Score | double | health_score | numeric(3,0) | | | | MRR__c | MRR | currency | monthly_recurring_revenue | numeric(16,2) | | | | Primary_Contact__c | Primary Contact | reference | primary_contact_id | varchar(18) | | → | | Source_Opportunity__c | Source Opportunity | reference | source_opportunity_id | varchar(18) | | → | | Start_Date__c | Start Date | date | start_date | date | yes | | | Status__c | Status | picklist | status | text | yes | values: Draft, Active, Suspended, Cancelled, Renewed; default Draft | | Term_Months__c | Term (Months) | double | term_months | numeric(4,0) | | | | Line_Count__c | Line Count | double | line_count | numeric(18,0) | | | | Annual_Value__c | Annual Value | currency | annual_value | numeric(18,2) | | | | Days_To_Renewal__c | Days To Renewal | double | days_to_renewal | numeric(18,0) | | | | Total_Line_Value__c | Total Line Value | currency | total_line_value | numeric(18,2) | | | ### Subscription Line (`Subscription_Line__c` → `subscription_line`) 219 rows. Sharing: ControlledByParent, inherited through Subscription_Line__c.Subscription__c. | Salesforce field | Label | Salesforce type | Column | PostgreSQL type | Required | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | Id | Record ID | id | id | varchar(18) | yes | | | Name | Line Number | string | line_number | varchar(80) | | | | Subscription__c | Subscription | reference | subscription_id | varchar(18) | yes | → | | Product__c | Product | reference | product_id | varchar(18) | | → | | Quantity__c | Quantity | double | quantity | numeric(6,0) | yes | | | Unit_Price__c | Unit Price | currency | unit_price | numeric(16,2) | yes | | | Account_Name__c | Account Name | string | account_name | varchar(1300) | | | | Line_Total__c | Line Total | currency | line_total | numeric(18,2) | | | ## 2. Calculated fields | Field | Kind | Salesforce definition | Target design | |---|---|---|---| | Subscription_Line__c.Account_Name__c | formula | Subscription__r.Account__r.Name | view that joins the parent records | | Subscription_Line__c.Line_Total__c | formula | Quantity__c * Unit_Price__c | generated column, stored | | Subscription__c.Line_Count__c | rollup | count of undefined | column kept current by triggers, with a recompute job | | Subscription__c.Annual_Value__c | formula | MRR__c * 12 | generated column, stored | | Subscription__c.Days_To_Renewal__c | formula | End_Date__c - TODAY() | computed when read (depends on today’s date) | | Subscription__c.Total_Line_Value__c | rollup | sum of Subscription_Line__c.Line_Total__c | column kept current by triggers, with a recompute job | ## 3. Validation rules | Rule | Rejects when | Message | Target design | |---|---|---|---| | Opportunity: Closed_Won_Requires_Amount | AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), OR( ISBLANK(Amount), Amount <= 0 ) ) | A won opportunity must have an Amount greater than zero. | CHECK constraint on the table | | Opportunity: Loss_Reason_Required_When_Lost | AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Loss_Reason__c)) ) | A Loss Reason is required before an opportunity can be marked Closed Lost. | CHECK constraint on the table | | Subscription Line: Parent_Not_Cancelled | ISPICKVAL(Subscription__r.Status__c, "Cancelled") | You cannot add or change lines on a cancelled subscription. | BEFORE trigger guard (needs the previous row) | | Subscription Line: Quantity_Must_Be_Positive | Quantity__c <= 0 | Quantity must be greater than zero. | CHECK constraint on the table | | Subscription: Active_Requires_MRR | AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Active"), OR( ISBLANK(MRR__c), MRR__c <= 0 ) ) | An active subscription must have an MRR greater than zero. | CHECK constraint on the table | | Subscription: Cancellation_Reason_Required | AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Cancelled"), ISBLANK(Cancellation_Reason__c) ) | Cancellation Reason is required when Status is Cancelled. | CHECK constraint on the table | | Subscription: End_Date_After_Start_Date | AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Date__c)), End_Date__c <= Start_Date__c ) | End Date must be after Start Date. | CHECK constraint on the table | | Subscription: No_Reactivation_After_Cancel | AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Cancelled"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Cancelled")) ) | A cancelled subscription cannot be reactivated. Create a new subscription instead. | BEFORE trigger guard (needs the previous row) | ## 4. Automations | Automation | Runs when | Does | Target design | Status | |---|---|---|---|---| | flow: Subscription At Risk Alert | after insert/update of Subscription | create Task | in_transaction_hook | pending | | apexTrigger: OpportunityTrigger | after update of Opportunity | OpportunityService.createSubscriptionsForWonDeals | service hook in the same transaction | pending | | apexTrigger: SubscriptionTrigger | before/before/after insert/update/update of Subscription | SubscriptionService.applyDefaults, SubscriptionService.handleStatusChange | service hook in the same transaction | partly translated | | apexClass: SubscriptionRenewalBatch | on a schedule | writes Task | scheduled worker job | pending | | duplicateRule: Account.Standard_Account_Duplicate_Rule | before insert/update of Account | | rule engine hook in the service layer | pending | | duplicateRule: Contact.Standard_Contact_Duplicate_Rule | before insert/update of Contact | | rule engine hook in the service layer | pending | ### 4.1 Order of execution: subscription ```mermaid sequenceDiagram autonumber actor U as User or integration participant SF as Subscription participant SubscriptionService as SubscriptionService U->>SF: create or update a subscription SF->>SubscriptionService: before save: applyDefaults() SF->>SF: validation rules (4) Note right of SF: Active Requires MRR
Cancellation Reason Required
End Date After Start Date
No Reactivation After Cancel SF->>SubscriptionService: after save: handleStatusChange() SubscriptionService-->>SF: insert Task participant Flow as Flow SF->>Flow: Subscription At Risk Alert Note right of Flow: when AND( Health_Score__c #lt; 50, Status__c = Active ) Flow-->>SF: create Task SF-->>U: saved, or the first failing rule’s message ``` ### 4.2 Order of execution: subscription line ```mermaid sequenceDiagram autonumber actor U as User or integration participant SF as Subscription Line U->>SF: add or change a subscription line SF->>SF: validation rules (2) Note right of SF: Parent Not Cancelled
Quantity Must Be Positive SF->>SF: recalculate Line Count, Total Line Value on Subscription SF-->>U: saved, or the first failing rule’s message ``` ### 4.3 Flow: Subscription At Risk Alert ```mermaid flowchart TD START(["Subscription created or updated
after save"]) FILTER{{"AND( Health Score #lt; 50, Status = Active )"}} START --> FILTER FILTER -- "no" --> SKIP(["no action"]) Create_Health_Check_Task["create Task
Create Health Check Task"] FILTER -- "yes" --> Create_Health_Check_Task classDef el fill:#F3F1FC,stroke:#6666CC,color:#1F1F2E; ``` ## 5. Services | Class | Methods | Reads | Writes | Called by | Constants | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | OpportunityService | createSubscriptionsForWonDeals | Subscription | Subscription | OpportunityTrigger | DEFAULT_TERM_MONTHS = 12 | | SubscriptionService | applyDefaults, handleStatusChange, totalActiveMrr | Subscription | Task | SubscriptionTrigger | DEFAULT_HEALTH_SCORE = 70, AT_RISK_THRESHOLD = 50 | ## 6. Security | Role (from Salesforce) | Subscription | Subscription Line | |---|---|---| | Profile: Admin | read, create, edit, delete, viewAll, modifyAll | read, create, edit, delete, viewAll, modifyAll | | Profile: Analytics Cloud Integration User | read, viewAll | read, viewAll | | Permission set: Subscription_Management | read, create, edit, delete | read, create, edit, delete | ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph SFS["Salesforce"] profile_Admin["Profile: Admin"] profile_Analytics_Cloud_Integration_User["Profile: Analytics Cloud Integration User"] permissionSet_Subscription_Management["Permission set: Subscription_Management"] OWD["Account sharing
(org-wide default)"] end subgraph PG["PostgreSQL"] PG_profile_Admin["role admin"] PG_profile_Analytics_Cloud_Integration_User["role analytics cloud integration user"] PG_permissionSet_Subscription_Management["role subscription_management"] RLS["row-level security
can_access_account()"] COL["column grants

inherit access from the account"] --> RLS ``` ## 7. Data load | Order | Object | Rows | Depends on | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | Account | 22 | — | | 1 | Product | 17 | — | | 2 | Contact | 20 | Account | | 3 | Opportunity | 31 | Account, Contact | | 4 | Subscription | 107 | Account, Contact, Opportunity | | 5 | Subscription Line | 219 | Subscription, Product | ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph L0["Level 1"] Account["Account
